$comment: The one row grid of every cmux NEXT menu (Leo 2026-10-21, on Lawrence's screenshots of the sidebar group menu and the pane [+] menu: "idk if we generalized the left alignment across all stuff yet"). Points from the menu's leading edge, or from its trailing edge for `trailing`. Right-click and ⋮ menus, the group editors, the palette's menus, page popups and the webviews' menus all read these. scripts/cmux-next/gen-menu-metrics.py writes the Swift copy (CmuxNextDesign/MenuMetrics.generated.swift) and the CSS copy (--cmux-menu-<name> in webviews/src/pages/shared/desktop.css); scripts/cmux-next/check-menu-metrics.py fails a menu that sets its own.

metrics.name: highlightInset
metrics.for: the hover highlight's distance from the menu's edges

metrics.name: separatorInset
metrics.for: a separator's distance from the menu's edges, on both sides

metrics.name: iconX
metrics.for: the icon column; also the text column of a menu with no icon

metrics.name: iconGap
metrics.for: between the icon column and the text

metrics.name: trailing
metrics.for: a shortcut's or submenu chevron's distance from the trailing edge

metrics.name: shortcutGap
metrics.for: the least room between a title and its shortcut or chevron
